---
# ==============================================================================
# PROFESSIONAL REPORT TEMPLATE
# ==============================================================================
# 
# This template provides styled components for professional paged reports.
#
# FILES REQUIRED:
#   - brochure.css (component styles)
#   - header_overrides.html (headers/footers/footnotes)
#
# AVAILABLE COMPONENTS (see examples below):
#   - Infoboxes: .infobox .info|.success|.warning|.danger|.primary|.secondary
#   - Callouts: .callout .tip|.warning|.danger|.info|.success
#   - Value boxes: .value-box .primary|.secondary|.accent|.warning|.danger
#   - Badges: .badge .primary|.success|.warning|.danger|.info|.light
#   - Progress bars: .progress-container with .progress-fill
#   - Timeline: .timeline with .timeline-item
#   - Process steps: .process-steps with .process-step
#   - Metric cards: .metric-card
#   - Key findings: .key-finding .success|.warning|.danger|.info
#   - Summary box: .summary-box
#   - Quote box: .quote-box
#   - Scorecard: .scorecard with .scorecard-item
#   - Tables: standard or .comparison-table
#   - Lists: .striped-list, .feature-list, .icon-list
#   - Grids: .grid-2, .grid-3, .grid-4
#   - Section breaks: .section-break .primary|.secondary|.accent
#   - Footnotes: <span class="footnote">text</span>
#
# ==============================================================================

# --- Document Metadata ---
title: "Rapport de nettoyage des rendements"
subtitle: "Analyse des donnees de rendement"
author: "YieldCleanr"
date: "Date : Février 2026"

# --- Header/Footer Text ---
header-left: "Rapport de nettoyage des rendements"           # Top-left
header-middle: ""                         # Top-center (optional)
header-right: "IRDA"                      # Top-right
footer-left: ""                           # Bottom-left (hidden when page number is here)
footer-middle: ""                         # Bottom-center (optional)
footer-right: "Février 2026"              # Bottom-right (hidden when page number is here)

# --- Page Number Position ---
# "right" = always right | "alternate" = book-style (left on even, right on odd)
page-number-position: "alternate"

# --- Output Settings ---
output:
  pagedown::html_paged:
    css: 
      - "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.0.0/css/all.min.css"
      - "default-page"
      - "default"
      - "brochure.css"
    number_sections: false
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    toc_title: "Table des matières"
    includes:
      in_header: header_overrides.html
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(fontawesome)
library(ggspatial)
if (!exists("n_raw")) n_raw <- 0
if (!exists("n_clean")) n_clean <- 0
if (!exists("n_deleted")) n_deleted <- 0
if (!exists("retention_rate")) retention_rate <- 0
if (!exists("yield_mean")) yield_mean <- 0
if (!exists("yield_sd")) yield_sd <- 0
if (!exists("yield_min")) yield_min <- 0
if (!exists("yield_max")) yield_max <- 0
if (!exists("gdf")) gdf <- NULL

safe_val <- function(x, default = 0) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(default)
  val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (is.na(val) || is.nan(val) || is.infinite(val)) return(default)
  return(val)
}

# Calculer toutes les statistiques
yield_median <- 0
moisture_mean <- 0

# Initialiser les variables de champ si elles n'existent pas
if (!exists("field_name")) field_name <- NA_character_
if (!exists("season_year")) season_year <- NA_integer_
if (!exists("crop_name")) crop_name <- NA_character_
if (!exists("farm_name")) farm_name <- NA_character_
if (!exists("harvest_date")) harvest_date <- NA_character_

# Preparer les libelles pour l'affichage
field_label <- if (!is.na(field_name) && field_name != "") paste0(field_name) else "Champ"

# Utiliser year_label tel que défini dans l'app (déjà formaté avec la date de récolte)
# ou le créer à partir de harvest_date/season_year si nécessaire
if (!exists("year_label") || is.null(year_label) || year_label == "") {
  if (!is.na(harvest_date) && harvest_date != "") {
    tryCatch({
      date_parsed <- as.Date(harvest_date)
      year_label <- format(date_parsed, "%d %b %Y")
    }, error = function(e) {
      year_label <- if (!is.na(season_year)) as.character(season_year) else ""
    })
  } else {
    year_label <- if (!is.na(season_year)) as.character(season_year) else ""
  }
}
# Fonction de traduction des cultures
translate_crop <- function(crop) {
  crop_lower <- tolower(crop)
  translations <- list(
    "corn" = "Maïs",
    "maize" = "Maïs",
    "soybean" = "Soya",
    "soy" = "Soya",
    "wheat" = "Blé",
    "barley" = "Orge",
    "oats" = "Avoine",
    "canola" = "Canola",
    "rapeseed" = "Canola",
    "alfalfa" = "Luzerne"
  )
  if (crop_lower %in% names(translations)) {
    return(translations[[crop_lower]])
  } else {
    # Retourner avec première lettre en majuscule
    return(paste0(toupper(substring(crop, 1, 1)), substring(crop, 2)))
  }
}

# Utiliser crop_label tel que défini dans l'app (déjà traduit)
# ou créer à partir de crop_name si nécessaire
if (!exists("crop_label") || is.null(crop_label) || crop_label == "") {
  crop_label <- if (!is.na(crop_name) && crop_name != "") crop_name else ""
}

if (exists("gdf") && !is.null(gdf) && inherits(gdf, "sf") && nrow(gdf) > 0) {
  if ("Yield_kg_ha" %in% names(gdf)) {
    valid_yield <- gdf$Yield_kg_ha[!is.na(gdf$Yield_kg_ha) & !is.nan(gdf$Yield_kg_ha) & is.finite(gdf$Yield_kg_ha)]
    if (length(valid_yield) > 0) {
      yield_mean <- mean(valid_yield)
      yield_sd <- sd(valid_yield)
      yield_min <- min(valid_yield)
      yield_max <- max(valid_yield)
      yield_median <- median(valid_yield)
    }
  }
  # Chercher colonne humidite
  moisture_col <- NULL
  for (col in names(gdf)) {
    if (grepl("(?i)moisture|humid|water", col)) {
      moisture_col <- col
      break
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(moisture_col)) {
    valid_moisture <- gdf[[moisture_col]][!is.na(gdf[[moisture_col]]) & !is.nan(gdf[[moisture_col]]) & is.finite(gdf[[moisture_col]])]
    if (length(valid_moisture) > 0) {
      moisture_mean <- mean(valid_moisture)
    }
  }
}

n_raw <- safe_val(n_raw)
n_clean <- safe_val(n_clean)
n_deleted <- safe_val(n_deleted)
retention_rate <- safe_val(retention_rate)
yield_mean <- safe_val(yield_mean)
yield_sd <- safe_val(yield_sd)
yield_min <- safe_val(yield_min)
yield_max <- safe_val(yield_max)
yield_median <- safe_val(yield_median)
```

```{r calculate-bins, include=FALSE}
# Calculer les bins centrés sur la médiane avec le bin médian en jaune
yield_bins <- NULL
bin_colors <- NULL
breaks_custom <- NULL
median_bin_index <- NULL

if (exists("gdf") && !is.null(gdf) && inherits(gdf, "sf") && nrow(gdf) > 0) {
  if ("Yield_kg_ha" %in% names(gdf)) {
    valid_yield <- gdf$Yield_kg_ha[!is.na(gdf$Yield_kg_ha) & !is.nan(gdf$Yield_kg_ha) & is.finite(gdf$Yield_kg_ha)]
    
    if (length(valid_yield) > 0) {
      # Calculer la médiane directement
      med <- median(valid_yield)
      
      # Objectif: ajuster la granularité selon la concentration aux extrémités
      yield_min <- min(valid_yield)
      yield_max <- max(valid_yield)
      med <- median(valid_yield, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      # Fonction pour calculer les breaks et obtenir les pourcentages des extrémités
      calc_edge_percentages <- function(bin_size, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max) {
        med_bin_start <- floor(med / bin_size) * bin_size
        n_side <- 3
        n_bins_target <- 7
        
        breaks_custom <- c()
        start_val <- med_bin_start - (n_side * bin_size)
        
        for (i in 0:n_bins_target) {
          breaks_custom <- c(breaks_custom, start_val + (i * bin_size))
        }
        
        # Étendre si nécessaire
        if (yield_min < breaks_custom[1]) breaks_custom[1] <- yield_min - 1
        if (yield_max > breaks_custom[length(breaks_custom)]) breaks_custom[length(breaks_custom)] <- yield_max + 1
        
        # Calculer les pourcentages
        labels <- 1:(length(breaks_custom)-1)
        yield_cut <- cut(valid_yield, breaks = breaks_custom, labels = labels, include.lowest = TRUE)
        bin_counts <- table(yield_cut)
        bin_percentages <- as.numeric(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) * 100
        
        # Retourner le pourcentage moyen du premier et dernier bin
        first_pct <- bin_percentages[1]
        last_pct <- bin_percentages[length(bin_percentages)]
        avg_edge <- (first_pct + last_pct) / 2
        
        return(list(avg_edge = avg_edge, breaks = breaks_custom, bin_size = bin_size))
      }
      
      # Tester avec 0.5t d'abord
      result_05 <- calc_edge_percentages(500, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
      avg_edge_05 <- result_05$avg_edge
      
      # Progression: augmenter la taille des bins jusqu'à ce que les extrémités < 10%
      if (avg_edge_05 < 2) {
        # Très peu de données aux extrémités → utiliser 0.25t
        bin_size <- 250
      } else if (avg_edge_05 <= 10) {
        # Cas idéal → rester à 0.5t
        bin_size <- 500
      } else {
        # Trop de données aux extrémités → tester avec des bins plus larges
        # Tester 1t
        result_1 <- calc_edge_percentages(1000, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
        avg_edge_1 <- result_1$avg_edge
        
        if (avg_edge_1 <= 10) {
          bin_size <- 1000
        } else {
          # Tester 1.5t
          result_15 <- calc_edge_percentages(1500, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
          avg_edge_15 <- result_15$avg_edge
          
          if (avg_edge_15 <= 10) {
            bin_size <- 1500
            } else {
              # Tester 2t
              result_2 <- calc_edge_percentages(2000, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
              avg_edge_2 <- result_2$avg_edge
              
              if (avg_edge_2 <= 10) {
                bin_size <- 2000
              } else {
                # Tester 2.5t
                result_25 <- calc_edge_percentages(2500, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
                avg_edge_25 <- result_25$avg_edge
                
                if (avg_edge_25 <= 10) {
                  bin_size <- 2500
                } else {
                  # Tester 3t
                  result_3 <- calc_edge_percentages(3000, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
                  avg_edge_3 <- result_3$avg_edge
                  
                  if (avg_edge_3 <= 10) {
                    bin_size <- 3000
                  } else {
                    # Tester 3.5t
                    result_35 <- calc_edge_percentages(3500, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
                    avg_edge_35 <- result_35$avg_edge
                    
                    if (avg_edge_35 <= 10) {
                      bin_size <- 3500
                    } else {
                      # Tester 4t
                      result_4 <- calc_edge_percentages(4000, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
                      avg_edge_4 <- result_4$avg_edge
                      
                      if (avg_edge_4 <= 10) {
                        bin_size <- 4000
                      } else {
                        # Tester 4.5t
                        result_45 <- calc_edge_percentages(4500, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
                        avg_edge_45 <- result_45$avg_edge
                        
                        if (avg_edge_45 <= 10) {
                          bin_size <- 4500
                        } else {
                          # Tester avec des bins plus larges pour rendements eleves (cultures maraicheres)
                          result_6 <- calc_edge_percentages(6000, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
                          if (result_6$avg_edge <= 10) {
                            bin_size <- 6000
                          } else {
                            result_8 <- calc_edge_percentages(8000, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
                            if (result_8$avg_edge <= 10) {
                              bin_size <- 8000
                            } else {
                              result_10 <- calc_edge_percentages(10000, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
                              if (result_10$avg_edge <= 10) {
                                bin_size <- 10000
                              } else {
                                result_12 <- calc_edge_percentages(12000, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
                                if (result_12$avg_edge <= 10) {
                                  bin_size <- 12000
                                } else {
                                  result_15 <- calc_edge_percentages(15000, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
                                  if (result_15$avg_edge <= 10) {
                                    bin_size <- 15000
                                  } else {
                                    result_20 <- calc_edge_percentages(20000, valid_yield, med, yield_min, yield_max)
                                    if (result_20$avg_edge <= 10) {
                                      bin_size <- 20000
                                    } else {
                                      # Par defaut utiliser 25000 (25 t/ha)
                                      bin_size <- 25000
                                    }
                                  }
                                }
                              }
                            }
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      
      # Créer les breaks avec des bins de taille uniforme (sauf extrémités)
      n_bins_target <- 7
      
      # Calculer la valeur de départ pour avoir exactement 7 bins avec la médiane au centre
      # On veut 3 bins complets sous la médiane, la médiane dans le 4ème, et 3 au-dessus
      # Partir d'une valeur alignée sur la taille des bins
      med_rounded <- floor(med / bin_size) * bin_size
      
      # Créer les breaks centrés sur la médiane
      breaks_custom <- c()
      for (i in -3:3) {
        breaks_custom <- c(breaks_custom, med_rounded + (i * bin_size))
      }
      # Ajouter le dernier break pour le 7ème bin
      breaks_custom <- c(breaks_custom, med_rounded + (4 * bin_size))
      
      # Ajuster les extrémités pour couvrir toutes les données
      # Le premier break doit être < yield_min, le dernier > yield_max
      if (yield_min < breaks_custom[1]) {
        breaks_custom[1] <- floor(yield_min / bin_size) * bin_size - bin_size
      }
      if (yield_max > breaks_custom[length(breaks_custom)]) {
        breaks_custom[length(breaks_custom)] <- ceiling(yield_max / bin_size) * bin_size + bin_size
      }
      
      # Recalculer le nombre de bins après ajustement
      n_bins <- length(breaks_custom) - 1
      
      # Identifier l'index du bin qui contient la médiane
      median_bin_index <- which(breaks_custom[-length(breaks_custom)] <= med & med < breaks_custom[-1])
      if (length(median_bin_index) == 0) median_bin_index <- 4  # Fallback
      
      # Créer les labels
      labels <- c()
      for (i in 1:n_bins) {
        val1 <- breaks_custom[i] / 1000
        val2 <- breaks_custom[i+1] / 1000
        # Nombre de décimales selon la taille des bins
        decimals <- ifelse(bin_size <= 500, 2, ifelse(bin_size <= 1000, 1, 0))
        val1_rounded <- round(val1, decimals)
        val2_rounded <- round(val2, decimals)
        
        if (i == 1) {
          labels <- c(labels, paste0("< ", val2_rounded, " t/ha"))
        } else if (i == n_bins) {
          labels <- c(labels, paste0("> ", val1_rounded, " t/ha"))
        } else {
          labels <- c(labels, paste0(val1_rounded, " - ", val2_rounded, " t/ha"))
        }
      }
      
      # Calculer les pourcentages et superficies
      yield_cut <- cut(valid_yield, breaks = breaks_custom, labels = labels, include.lowest = TRUE)
      bin_counts <- table(yield_cut)
      bin_percentages <- round(bin_counts / sum(bin_counts) * 100, 1)
      
      # Calculer la superficie par bin (en hectares)
      bin_areas <- numeric(length(labels))
      gdf$yield_bin <- cut(gdf$Yield_kg_ha, breaks = breaks_custom, labels = labels, include.lowest = TRUE)
      
      for (i in 1:length(labels)) {
        bin_data <- gdf[gdf$yield_bin == labels[i] & !is.na(gdf$yield_bin), ]
        if (nrow(bin_data) > 0) {
          area_m2 <- sum(as.numeric(st_area(bin_data)), na.rm = TRUE)
          bin_areas[i] <- round(area_m2 / 10000, 1)
        } else {
          bin_areas[i] <- 0
        }
      }
      
      # Créer le dataframe
      yield_bins <- data.frame(
        Classe = labels,
        Pourcentage = as.numeric(bin_percentages),
        Superficie = bin_areas
      )
      
      # Palette de couleurs avec LE BIN MÉDIAN EN JAUNE
      bin_colors <- character(n_bins)
      
      # Couleurs pour les bins sous la médiane (rouge à orange)
      if (median_bin_index > 1) {
        reds <- colorRampPalette(c("#C0392B", "#E74C3C", "#E67E22"))(median_bin_index - 1)
        bin_colors[1:(median_bin_index-1)] <- reds
      }
      
      # Le bin médian en JAUNE
      bin_colors[median_bin_index] <- "#F1C40F"
      
      # Couleurs pour les bins au-dessus de la médiane (vert clair à vert foncé)
      if (median_bin_index < n_bins) {
        greens <- colorRampPalette(c("#AED136", "#27AE60", "#1E8449"))(n_bins - median_bin_index)
        bin_colors[(median_bin_index+1):n_bins] <- greens
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r calculate-orientation, include=FALSE}
# Valeurs par défaut
map_orientation <- list(angle = 0, width = 7, height = 5, coord_ratio = 7/5)

  tryCatch({
  if (exists("gdf") && !is.null(gdf) && inherits(gdf, "sf") && nrow(gdf) > 0) {
    if ("Yield_kg_ha" %in% names(gdf)) {
      valid_idx <- !is.na(gdf$Yield_kg_ha) & !is.nan(gdf$Yield_kg_ha) & is.finite(gdf$Yield_kg_ha)
      if (sum(valid_idx) > 0) {
        field_angle <- NULL
        
        # Calculer l'angle a partir des positions (segment directions)
        tryCatch({
          coords <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_centroid(gdf))
          if (!is.null(coords) && nrow(coords) > 1) {
            lat <- mean(coords[, 2], na.rm = TRUE)
            meters_per_degree_lon <- 111320 * cos(lat * pi / 180)
            meters_per_degree_lat <- 111320
            dx_m <- diff(coords[, 1]) * meters_per_degree_lon
            dy_m <- diff(coords[, 2]) * meters_per_degree_lat
            angles <- atan2(dy_m, dx_m) * 180 / pi
            angles_valid <- angles[!is.na(angles) & (abs(dx_m) > 0.1 | abs(dy_m) > 0.1)]
            if (length(angles_valid) > 10) {
              angles_180 <- angles_valid %% 180
              h <- hist(angles_180, breaks = 36, plot = FALSE)
              peak_idx <- which.max(h$counts)
              peak_angle <- h$mids[peak_idx]
              field_angle <- peak_angle
            }
          }
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        # Si pas de segments valides, utiliser le bounding box
        if (is.null(field_angle)) {
          invisible(capture.output({
            bbox_calc <- sf::st_bbox(sf::st_geometry(gdf))
          }))
          lat <- (as.numeric(bbox_calc["ymin"]) + as.numeric(bbox_calc["ymax"])) / 2
          meters_per_degree_lat <- 111320
          meters_per_degree_lon <- 111320 * cos(lat * pi / 180)
          
          bbox_width_m <- (as.numeric(bbox_calc["xmax"]) - as.numeric(bbox_calc["xmin"])) * meters_per_degree_lon
          bbox_height_m <- (as.numeric(bbox_calc["ymax"]) - as.numeric(bbox_calc["ymin"])) * meters_per_degree_lat
          
          bbox_angle <- atan2(bbox_height_m, bbox_width_m) * 180 / pi
          field_angle <- -bbox_angle
        }

        # Normaliser l'angle final pour qu'il soit entre -90 et 90
        while (field_angle > 90) field_angle <- field_angle - 180
        while (field_angle <= -90) field_angle <- field_angle + 180
        
        # Mettre à jour map_orientation
        map_orientation <- list(
          angle = field_angle,
          width = 7,
          height = 5,
          coord_ratio = 7/5
        )
      }
    }
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Error in calculate-orientation: ", e$message)
})

if (exists("gdf") && !is.null(gdf) && inherits(gdf, "sf") && nrow(gdf) > 0) {
    if ("Yield_kg_ha" %in% names(gdf) && !is.null(yield_bins)) {
      valid_idx <- !is.na(gdf$Yield_kg_ha) & !is.nan(gdf$Yield_kg_ha) & is.finite(gdf$Yield_kg_ha)
      if (sum(valid_idx) > 0) {
        valid_data <- gdf[valid_idx, ]
        valid_data <- valid_data |> sf::st_transform(3857)
        # Créer une variable discrète pour les bins
        valid_data$yield_bin <- cut(valid_data$Yield_kg_ha, 
                                    breaks = breaks_custom, 
                                    labels = yield_bins$Classe, 
                                    include.lowest = TRUE)
        
        # Créer une palette nommée pour les couleurs
        names(bin_colors) <- yield_bins$Classe
        
        # Récupérer l'orientation pré-calculée
        rotation_angle <- map_orientation$angle
        
        # Créer la carte avec rotation si nécessaire
        if (abs(rotation_angle) > 5) {  # Seulement si l'angle est significatif (> 5 degrés)
          # Utiliser coord_rotate pour faire tourner la carte avec le ratio optimisé
          rot <- ggbasemap::coord_rotate(valid_data, rotation_angle, ratio = map_orientation$coord_ratio)
          
          p <- ggplot() +
            ggbasemap::add_basemap(
                                   bbox = rot$bbox,
                                   url = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
                                   alpha = 0.3, 
                                   zoom_offset = 0) +
            geom_sf(data = valid_data, aes(fill = yield_bin), color = NA, size = 0.1) +
            scale_fill_manual(
              values = bin_colors,
              name = "Rendement",
              drop = FALSE
            ) +
            ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(
              which_north = "true",
              location = "tr",
              pad_x = unit(0.4, "cm"),
              pad_y = unit(0.4, "cm"),
              height = unit(1.8, "cm"),
              width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
              style = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(
                fill = c("#002752", "white"),
                line_col = "#002752",
                line_width = 1,
                text_col = "#002752",
                text_face = "bold",
                text_size = 12
              )
            )+
            ggspatial::annotation_scale(
              location = "br",
              pad_x = unit(0.4, "cm"),
              pad_y = unit(0.4, "cm"),
              width_hint = 0.2,
              line_width = 1,
              line_col = "#002752",
              text_col = "#002752",
              text_cex = 0.9
            )+
            annotate(
              "text",
              x = -Inf,
              y = -Inf,
              label = "Source: Esri World Imagery",
              hjust = 0,
              vjust = -0.5,
              size = 3,
              color = "#002752",
              fontface = "italic"
            )+
            rot$coord +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(
              axis.text = element_blank(),
              axis.title = element_blank(),
              panel.grid = element_blank(),
              legend.position = "none",
              plot.margin = margin(2, 0, 2, 0)
            )
        } else {
          # Sans rotation
          p <- ggplot(valid_data) +
            ggbasemap::add_basemap(valid_data,
                                   url = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
                                   alpha = 0.3, 
                                   zoom_offset = 0) +
            geom_sf(aes(fill = yield_bin), color = NA, size = 0.1) +
            scale_fill_manual(
              values = bin_colors,
              name = "Rendement",
              drop = FALSE
            ) +
            ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(
              which_north = "true",
              location = "tr",
              pad_x = unit(0.4, "cm"),
              pad_y = unit(0.4, "cm"),
              height = unit(1.8, "cm"),
              width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
              style = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(
                fill = c("#002752", "white"),
                line_col = "#002752",
                line_width = 1,
                text_col = "#002752",
                text_face = "bold",
                text_size = 12
              )
            ) +
            ggspatial::annotation_scale(
              location = "br",
              pad_x = unit(0.4, "cm"),
              pad_y = unit(0.4, "cm"),
              width_hint = 0.2,
              line_width = 1,
              line_col = "#002752",
              text_col = "#002752",
              text_cex = 0.9
            ) +
            annotate(
              "text",
              x = -Inf,
              y = -Inf,
              label = "Source: Esri World Imagery",
              hjust = 0,
              vjust = -0.5,
              size = 3,
              color = "#002752",
              fontface = "italic"
            )+
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(
              axis.text = element_blank(),
              axis.title = element_blank(),
              panel.grid = element_blank(),
              legend.position = "none",
              plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
            )
        }}}}
```

```{r yield-table, eval=TRUE, results='asis'}
# Ensure yield_bins exists
if (!exists("yield_bins")) yield_bins <- NULL
if (!exists("bin_colors")) bin_colors <- NULL

if (!is.null(yield_bins) && nrow(yield_bins) > 0 && !is.null(bin_colors)) {
  html_table <- "<table class='yield-table' style='width:100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 10pt;'>"
  html_table <- paste0(
    html_table,
    "<thead><tr style='background-color: #002752; color: white;'>",
    "<th style='padding: 4px; text-align: left;'>Classe</th>",
    "<th style='padding: 4px; text-align: center;'>%</th>",
    "<th style='padding: 4px; text-align: center;'>Superficie (ha)</th></tr></thead><tbody>"
  )
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(yield_bins)) {
    color <- bin_colors[i]
    classe_label <- yield_bins$Classe[i]
    
    html_table <- paste0(html_table, 
      "<tr style='border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;'>",
      "<td style='padding: 3px;'><span style='display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; ",
      "background-color: ", color, "; margin-right: 6px; border-radius: 2px;'></span>", classe_label, "</td>",
      "<td style='padding: 3px; text-align: center; font-weight: bold;'>", yield_bins$Pourcentage[i], "%</td>",
      "<td style='padding: 3px; text-align: center; color: #666;'>", yield_bins$Superficie[i], "</td>",
      "</tr>")
  }
  
  html_table <- paste0(html_table, "</tbody></table>")
  cat(html_table)
} else {
  cat("<p style='color: #666; font-style: italic;'>Données de rendement non disponibles</p>")
}
```

```{r value-boxes, eval=TRUE, results='asis'}
# Ensure variables exist with defaults
if (!exists("yield_mean")) yield_mean <- 0
if (!exists("yield_median")) yield_median <- 0
if (!exists("moisture_mean")) moisture_mean <- 0

# Create value boxes
cat('
::: {.value-box .info style="padding: var(--spacing-xs); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);"}
', fontawesome::fa("chart-line", height = "1.2em"), '
<span class="label">Rendement moyen </span>
<span class="value">', round(yield_mean/1000, 1), ' t/ha</span>
<span class="label">Médiane: ', round(yield_median/1000, 1), ' t/ha</span>
:::
')

cat('
::: {.value-box .info style="margin-top: 15px; padding: var(--spacing-xs); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);"}
', fontawesome::fa("tint", height = "1.2em"), '
<span class="label">Humidité moyenne</span>
<span class="value">', round(moisture_mean, 1), '%</span>
:::
')
```
